title: Elf Bar 600 Pink Grapefruit Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elf Bar 600 Pink Grapefruit Prefilled Pods are built for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, providing a vibrant and citrus-led vape. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and delivers up to 600 puffs with a smooth MTL draw. This flavour delivers the sharp, tangy notes of Pink Grapefruit for a lively citrus experience that stays refreshing. Swapping pods is quick and easy, with no refilling or coil changes required.
